headlines.title: 精准施策营造适宜货币金融环境
headlines.summary: 【精准施策营造适宜货币金融环境】近日，两场重要会议接力为下半年货币金融工作锚定航向。7月30日，中央政治局召开会议分析研究当前经济形势并部署下半年经济工作，强调“实施好更加积极的财政政策和适度宽松的货币政策”“综合运用并适时调整货币政策工具”。8月1日，中国人民银行召开下半年工作会议，对标中央部署细化落实举措。

headlines.title_en: Precise policies create suitable monetary and financial environment
headlines.summary_en: Precise Policies to Create a Suitable Monetary and Financial Environment: Recently, two important meetings have successively set the course for monetary and financial work in the second half of the year. On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to analyze the current economic situation and deploy economic work for the second half of the year, emphasizing 'implementing a more proactive fiscal policy and a moderately loose monetary policy' and 'comprehensively utilizing and timely adjusting monetary policy tools.' On August 1, the People's Bank of China held its second-half work meeting to align with the central government's deployment and refine implementation measures.

headlines.title: 发力产品创新 持续增资扩容 外资公募加码布局中国资产
headlines.summary: 外资公募正加码布局中国资产。一批外资公募正密集发行权益类基金及“固收+”等含权类产品，同时积极投身产品创新。多家外资公募表示，当前推出新品，核心缘于对中国资本市场长期发展前景、权益资产配置价值的坚定看好，将持续深耕中国市场，把握投资机遇。 (上证报)

headlines.title_en: Foreign public funds intensify product innovation, expand capital, and increase allocation to Chinese assets
headlines.summary_en: Foreign public funds are intensifying their布局 in Chinese assets. A batch of foreign public funds are densely issuing equity funds and 'fixed income +' products containing equity components, while actively engaging in product innovation. Multiple foreign public funds stated that the core reason for launching new products now is their firm optimism about the long-term development prospects of China's capital market and the allocation value of equity assets, and they will continue to deeply cultivate the Chinese market and seize investment opportunities. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 贝森特称霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性
headlines.summary: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特日前在接受美国亚利桑那州地方电视台采访时说，随着地缘政治局势变化，今后越来越多能源运输将绕过霍尔木兹海峡。他认为，霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性。当地媒体报道，贝森特在采访中说，鉴于伊朗试图控制霍尔木兹海峡这条咽喉要道，海峡将无法回到过去的状态。他声称，在接下来两年时间里，海峡将变成一片普通水域，逐步变得不再那么重要。

headlines.title_en: Bessent says Strait of Hormuz will gradually lose strategic importance
headlines.summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a recent interview with a local TV station in Arizona, USA, that as geopolitical situations change, more and more energy transportation will bypass the Strait of Hormuz in the future. He believes that the Strait of Hormuz will gradually lose its strategic importance. According to local media reports, Bessent said in the interview that given Iran's attempts to control the Strait of Hormuz, a key throat, the strait will not return to its past state. He claimed that in the next two years, the strait will become an ordinary water area and gradually become less important.

headlines.title_en: 400,000 new enterprises in emerging industries; H1 national business entity data released
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the State Administration for Market Regulation show that enterprises in new industries and new tracks are gaining momentum, with the service industry's new consumption and high-tech services driving dual-wheel growth, accelerating manufacturing transformation, and showcasing bright spots in industrial development. Enterprises related to new industries and new tracks continue to add momentum. In the first half of the year, 561,000 new enterprises related to the '8 major emerging industries + 9 future industries' were established nationwide, maintaining a stable growth trend and injecting a source of fresh water into the development of new quality productive forces. First, emerging industries are accelerating growth. A total of 400,000 new enterprises related to the '8 major emerging industries,' an important layout for building the resilience of industrial and supply chains, were established, continuing to play an innovative leading role. Second, future industries are accelerating incubation. A total of 200,000 new enterprises related to the '9 future industries,' a forward-looking layout for seizing the high ground of science and technology, were established, showing enormous development potential and growth momentum. Third, some frontier fields are showing explosive growth.

headlines.title_en: Trump administration to allocate $2 billion to battery and materials companies
headlines.summary_en: The Trump administration has agreed to provide over $2 billion in funding for battery and critical mineral producers, further stepping up government investment with the goal of reducing US reliance on Chinese suppliers. Citing White House officials, media reported that President Trump plans to announce at a roundtable with mining executives on Friday that the Defense Department has committed to a $1.4 billion loan to next-generation battery maker Sila Nanotechnologies, and has signed agreements with three other companies.

headlines.title_en: On August 7, the Shanghai Export Containerized Freight Index stood at 3276.14 points, up 2.2% from the previous period
headlines.summary_en: On August 7, the Shanghai Export Container Comprehensive Freight Index released by the Shanghai Shipping Exchange Research Institute (preparatory) stood at 3276.14 points, up 2.2% from the previous period. According to the latest data released by the General Administration of Customs, China's exports in July increased by 23.9% year-on-year in US dollar terms, maintaining a high growth rate. The strong export performance provides long-term support for the stable development of China's export container shipping market.

headlines.title: 7月我国线下消费持续升温 消费支付金额同比增长2.2%
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委国家信息中心最新发布的先行指标显示，7月，我国线下消费持续升温，带动商品消费和服务消费协同向好。7月消费支付金额同比增长2.2%，增速较上月加快0.8个百分点。中小商户的经营活力稳步增强，反映中小商户经营状况的实体商业活力指数较上月提高3.1%。实体商户经营健康指数、线下消费者活力指数环比均有增长。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: In July, China's offline consumption continued to heat up, with consumer payment amounts up 2.2% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The latest leading indicators released by the National Information Center of the National Development and Reform Commission show that in July, China's offline consumption continued to heat up, driving coordinated improvement in goods consumption and service consumption. The amount of consumption payments increased by 2.2% year-on-year in July, with the growth rate accelerating by 0.8 percentage points from the previous month. The operating vitality of small and medium-sized merchants steadily increased, with the physical business vitality index reflecting the operating conditions of small and medium-sized merchants rising by 3.1% from the previous month. The physical merchant operating health index and offline consumer vitality index both increased month-on-month. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 生物制造驶入发展快车道 产业资本密集布局
headlines.summary: 近期生物制造赛道产业与资本动作密集。多家初创企业相继完成新一轮融资，华润双鹤、鲁抗医药等上市公司持续加大布局力度，产业落地节奏显著提速。业内人士认为，生物制造行业正处于从技术创新向产业应用加速转化的关键期。在技术突破、政策支持和资本涌入的多重驱动下，行业有望在未来5—10年实现规模化发展，成为全球制造业绿色转型的重要引擎。中国凭借完备的发酵产业基础和持续的政策支持，有望在全球生物制造竞争中占据重要地位。 (中证报)

headlines.title_en: Biomanufacturing accelerates onto the fast track, with industrial capital making intensive deployments
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the biomanufacturing sector has seen intensive industry and capital activities. Multiple startups have successively completed new rounds of financing, while listed companies such as China Resources Double Crane and Lukang Pharmaceutical have continuously increased their布局 efforts, significantly accelerating the pace of industry implementation. Industry insiders believe that the biomanufacturing industry is in a critical period of accelerating transformation from technological innovation to industrial application. Driven by multiple factors such as technological breakthroughs, policy support, and capital influx, the industry is expected to achieve large-scale development in the next 5-10 years, becoming an important engine for the green transformation of global manufacturing. China, with its complete fermentation industry foundation and continuous policy support, is expected to occupy an important position in global biomanufacturing competition. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 贷款利率定价基准“换锚” 利率市场化再进一步
headlines.summary: 近期，多家商业银行落地以DR（存款类金融机构间债券回购利率）为定价基准的企业贷款，标志着我国贷款利率定价基准多元化的探索提速。专家表示，持续丰富贷款定价参考基准，构建多元化基准利率体系，既是稳步推进利率市场化改革的重要举措，也有助于提升货币政策传导效能，更好地服务实体经济各类经营主体。 (中证报)

headlines.title_en: Loan pricing benchmark 'anchor switch' marks further progress in interest rate liberalization
headlines.summary_en: Recently, multiple commercial banks have implemented corporate loans priced based on the DR (deposit institution bond repurchase rate), marking an acceleration in the exploration of diversifying loan pricing benchmarks. Experts say that continuously enriching loan pricing reference benchmarks and building a diversified benchmark interest rate system is not only an important measure to steadily advance interest rate marketization reform, but also helps enhance the effectiveness of monetary policy transmission and better serve various business entities in the real economy. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 美国两年期国债收益率在非农日跌5个基点，本周累跌约9.6个基点
headlines.summary: 周五（8月7日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率跌3.24个基点，报4.6454%，北京时间20:30发布美国非农就业报告时从4.6678%跳水、20:47刷新日低至4.6007%，本周累计下跌8.93%，8月4日跌幅突出。 两年期美债收益率跌5.02个基点，报4.1952%，非农就业报告出炉时从4.2306%跳水、20:40刷新日低至4.1515%，本周累跌9.59个基点。

headlines.title_en: U.S. 2-year Treasury yield falls 5 bps on payrolls day, down ~9.6 bps for the week
headlines.summary_en: At the New York close on Friday (August 7), the US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield fell 3.24 basis points to 4.6454%. When the US nonfarm payroll report was released at 20:30 Beijing time, it plunged from 4.6678%, hitting a session low of 4.6007% at 20:47. It fell 8.93% for the week, with August 4 seeing a notable decline. The 2-year Treasury yield dropped 5.02 basis points to 4.1952%, plunging from 4.2306% when the payroll report was released, and hitting a session low of 4.1515% at 20:40. It was down 9.59 basis points for the week.

headlines.title: 上海国投先导参与投资智微凌峰基金
headlines.summary: 近日，上海国投先导公示对上海智微凌峰创业投资合伙企业（有限合伙）的投资。该基金由智微资本担任管理人，目标规模30亿元。LP阵容汇聚中微公司、澜起科技等半导体龙头的旗下平台，工业X射线检测领域企业日联科技的子公司，以及地方国资平台，形成“产业资本+国有资本”的深度联合。智微凌峰基金以半导体设备、零部件、材料及先进封装等集成电路核心环节为主攻方向，重点挖掘“卡脖子”领域的“隐形冠军”。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Guotou pilot fund participates in investment in Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Shanghai Guotou Pilot announced its investment in Shanghai Zhiwei Lingfeng Venture Capital Partnership (Limited Partnership). The fund, managed by Zhiwei Capital, has a target size of 3 billion yuan. The LP lineup includes platforms under semiconductor leaders such as AMEC and Montage Technology, subsidiaries of industrial X-ray inspection company NDT Technologies, and local state-owned capital platforms, forming a deep alliance of 'industrial capital + state-owned capital.' The Zhiwei Lingfeng fund focuses on core integrated circuit segments such as semiconductor equipment, components, materials, and advanced packaging, with a focus on exploring 'hidden champions' in 'bottleneck' areas.

headlines.title: 德意志银行：预计美国7月CPI环比上涨0.15%
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月8日讯，下周最重要的数据发布将是周三公布的美国7月CPI报告，随后周四将公布PPI数据。德意志银行美国经济学家预计，整体消费者价格环比上涨0.15%，6月为下降0.42%；核心CPI预计环比上涨0.26%，与6月持平。对于PPI数据，预计整体PPI环比上涨0.22%（此前为0.13%）。

headlines.title_en: Deutsche Bank: expects US July CPI to rise 0.15% month-on-month
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 8 - The most important data release next week will be the US July CPI report on Wednesday, followed by PPI data on Thursday. Deutsche Bank US economists expect overall consumer prices to rise 0.15% month-over-month, following a decline of 0.42% in June; core CPI is expected to rise 0.26% month-over-month, flat with June. For PPI data, overall PPI is expected to rise 0.22% month-over-month (previously 0.13%).

headlines.title: 香港保监局：密切关注内地有关金融产品税务安排
headlines.summary: 据财联社，近期报道称中国内地税务居民购买香港保险的收益被纳入征税范围。对此，香港保险监管局回应称，政府和保监局正密切注意内地有关金融产品税务安排的最新发展，同时会与业界保持紧密沟通。中国居民就境外投资收益必须依法申报及缴税的要求一直存在，市场不用过度解读或作出揣测。香港保险市场发展成熟，产品设计灵活先进，可提供货币选择、环球资产配置、人生规划、财富传承等专业服务，相信对内地客户有一定吸引力。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong Insurance Authority: closely monitoring tax arrangements for financial products on the mainland
headlines.summary_en: According to CLS, recent reports suggest that income from Hong Kong insurance purchased by mainland Chinese tax residents has been included in the taxable scope. In response, the Hong Kong Insurance Authority said that the government and the Insurance Authority are closely monitoring the latest developments in tax arrangements for financial products on the mainland and maintaining close communication with the industry. The requirement for Chinese residents to declare and pay taxes on overseas investment income has always existed, and the market should not over-interpret or speculate. The Hong Kong insurance market is mature and developed, with flexible and advanced product design, offering professional services such as currency options, global asset allocation, life planning, and wealth succession, which is believed to have a certain appeal to mainland clients.

headlines.title: 禁止“抱团”抬价！东北明确新能源集中报价仅限同省同集团
headlines.summary: 据中国电力报，国家能源局东北监管局日前印发《东北区域集中式新能源发电企业集中报价工作实施方案（试行）》，对辽宁、吉林、黑龙江三省集中式风电、光伏发电企业的市场报价行为作出系统性规范。其中明确，原则上仅允许同一集团（同一母公司、同一控股股东、同一实际控制人等）内同一省的新能源发电企业进行集中报价，禁止跨集团、跨省集中报价。禁止具有竞争关系的经营者达成固定或变更商品关系的垄断协议。

headlines.title_en: Northeast China bans 'price-pushing' coalitions: centralized new-energy quotes restricted to same province, same group
headlines.summary_en: According to China Electric Power News, the Northeast Energy Regulatory Bureau of the National Energy Administration recently issued the 'Implementation Plan for Centralized Quoting by Centralized New Energy Generation Enterprises in the Northeast Region (Trial)', systematically regulating the market quoting behavior of centralized wind and photovoltaic power generation enterprises in Liaoning, Jilin, and Heilongjiang provinces. It clearly states that, in principle, only new energy generation enterprises within the same province and under the same group (same parent company, same controlling shareholder, same actual controller, etc.) are allowed to conduct centralized quoting, and cross-group and cross-province centralized quoting is prohibited. It also prohibits competing operators from reaching monopoly agreements that fix or change commodity relationships.

headlines.title: 7月我国主要港口货船离港载重量同比增长56.4%
headlines.summary: 今年以来，国家持续推动外贸“稳规模优结构”成效明显，外贸韧性持续增强。港口是外贸的晴雨表。7月，我国主要港口货运船舶离港载重量同比增长56.4%，增速比6月大幅提高38.9个百分点。

headlines.title_en: Cargo ship departures from major Chinese ports rose 56.4% year-on-year in July
headlines.summary_en: Since the beginning of this year, the country has continued to promote the optimization of foreign trade structure with visible results, and foreign trade resilience has continued to strengthen. Ports are a barometer of foreign trade. In July, the loaded cargo weight of ships departing from major ports in China increased by 56.4% year-on-year, with the growth rate significantly accelerating by 38.9 percentage points from June.
